description: Look up an Avalanche transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in AVAX, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use avax_receipt, for emitted events avax_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x186570f66bdbd9565ee4f5fe7ef9fc110ec5417f5838c3e7e322967cd1a7d3e2. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: avax_tx
title: Avalanche transaction
